reviews.text: Heather always does such an amazing job hand stripping my Irish Terrier. They’re very friendly and helpful with any questions, and are extra careful with her services due to her age. Always worth every penny!

We took our new adopted puppy, Logan, in for their first ever groom. I shared his short but intense history of abandonment and was quickly and effectively reassured. The staff took great care of him. He was picked up looking, smelling and acting better than ever. Grateful I found this place. Already booked his second groom for next month. Thanks, Rogers Bark team!
Extremely rude people.

We have been bringing our dog Rosie to Roger’s Bark for the past five years and couldn’t ask for a better place to trust with her care. This family-owned small business consistently goes above and beyond. The team is kind, respectful, incredibly professional, plus they run everything smoothly / on time.

Most importantly, they take wonderful care of Rosie every single visit. It’s clear they genuinely love and respect the animals they work with. Rosie always comes home looking great.

We’re so grateful to have such a reliable and caring grooming salon in the neighborhood. Highly recommend Roger’s Bark to anyone looking for a place that treats your pet like family!!
Talented and caring staff. Our standard poodle looks gorgeous!

My Shih Tzu, Lea, had an absolute blast at Roger’s Bark Pet Salon Inc. She received top-notch care and looked absolutely stunning when I picked her up. The staff was incredibly friendly and trustworthy, making it easy to communicate with them. Lea will definitely be returning soon!

My lab mix was straight up molting this week, she looked like a bird it was so bad, but I didn't have the energy to deal with it. I called Rogers Bark and they got her in for a groom (brush, bath, nail trim, etc) same day, they quoted 4 hours but she was done in under 3! And she looks and obviously feels so much better without all that extra hair. Plus both my senior girls love Rogers Bark, we bring both in for nail trims regularly! There's no dragging them in, they go in willingly and love sniffing all the treats you can buy and they love all the folks there that are just so kind! We 💜 Rogers Bark!

I've been coming here for 6 months since I adopted my dog earlier this year (a husky mix). He's from a shelter and I wasn't sure how he'd do with grooming. When I first took him in I warned the staff that he can sometimes be mouthy (he's a husky mix - very communicative about what he likes/doesn't like - but not aggressive). It took a few visits but the last 2-3 he's been getting rave reviews on how good he was doing.

So 6 months in, I drop him off for his usual and get a call an hour later with a vague description that he "came after" the bather and "got her sweatshirt", so they wouldn't finish the groom. I go to pick him up, they charged me half price for barely a bath and were very obviously treating me like a second class citizen. I asked for video footage (as I feel is my right) so I can understand the full picture and work with him on it and also be able to communicate in the future things he likes/doesn't like. I don't know what "go after" means in this context, I think they didn't want to say "attacked" but I know my dog and he wouldn't do that unprovoked or without clearly communicating in advance.

When I asked for video footage the salon went quiet and it got awkward (again I explained why - I got a vague explanation I deserve to know the full picture) and I was told the owner would follow up with me on it.

They made me go in the back to get him, he's soaking wet in his crate, very diminished. It wasn't said explicitly but I got the insinuation that we wouldn't be allowed back. He spent the rest of the day at home in a very defensive/protective state.

Since this, the owner has not called me on the date they said she would and I still have received no further context or information as to what happened.

I'm disappointed they wouldn't give someone who'd been coming regularly more information and treat them so coldly. Giving two stars because we had previous good experiences on the surface, but questioning a lot of that after this incident.

Just picked up my Westie, Daisy, she looks and smells great. The groomer isn’t Daisy’s idea of a good time but these ladies were so kind to her. They were kind to me as well. Daisy is ready to show off her clean coat and cute haircut!

Love this place! The ladies are terrific. We used to live a few blocks away and could walk my guy there. Then we moved 30 min away and didn't even need to think twice about making the drive up. I can't imagine bringing my pup to anyone else.

KIND BUSINESS ALERT
From the moment you call, you know you are calling someplace special. Eden, the receptionist, takes her time to explain your options. Roughly it is $80 for a 4 hour groom, teeth, nails appointment.  There are other add-ons all reasonably priced. Once you arrive, everyone is so kind and caring. You can just feel the positive energy when you walk in.  I was fortunate to have Heather as my groomer, but they all seem so nice. There are many other pet care places in the area, but will not find the positivity and passion like you do at Roger's Bark. In fact, Bark Place on Greenleaf, never even called me back and it's been over a week.  Bottom-line - Roger's Bark will exceed your expectations!
Great groomers and service.  Very kind and attentive.
I’ve been bringing my dogs here for many years. They do a great job, are very professional and my dogs never complain about how they’ve been treated.
We are so happy with the service here. Our dog came back looking incredible, the people were so nice, and the merchandise was fairly priced. PetSmart be damned!
They’re so kind! I just moved to the neighborhood and took my little schnauzer to them. They were thoughtful and happy to chat through styling him. Will always go to them in future.

Great service. Front desk staff was super nice and accommodating! Their pricing is good for all the services they do and they’re very kind. Could have easily overcharged me and they didn’t. Will be going back!
Twig looks like a different pup, so handsome and smug after his groom 😉🤩 …
Beaux needed a pedicure so I herd this place was great .. Well Beaux told me they were SOOO gentle and nice. Not to mention quick . Friendly happy people !!! Beaux asked when can we go back again 🐶 …
Niko was so happy after his day of pampering.

My dog hasn’t been groomed since he got home from the litter, but since he never really had a problem smelling or being dirty he’s never gone. However, one day he got into something, probably my fault for walking him somewhere we shouldn’t have, and he smelled like a sewer.

It was an emergency that neither my dog nor I were prepared for. Luckily, the groomers at Rogers Park were prepared indeed!

They overcame the attitude of my extremely fussy and uncompromising German Shepherd, a dog unacclimated to professional grooming. He left looking beautiful and smelling super clean. I want to commend their skill, steady hand, and professionalism, thank you for getting the job done Rogers Bark!

Our first time here and it was a lovely experience! I spent three hours as a nervous wreck because my Rory has never been boarded or professionally groomed before. When I picked her up she looked beautiful, smelled wonderful, and most importantly was happy as can be. She’s a very energetic and squirmy girl, so I had a fear she could accidentally get injured during her nail trim or when they cleaned her ears, but she was perfectly fine! Being away from her for three hours was absolutely worth it; I can tell the staff took their time with her and take pride in their work. <3 :)
Great business. Our dog has been groomed there twice and he has nothing but great things to say about his experience there.

I’m so glad we found Roger’s Bark for our standard poodle. They came highly recommended for poodles by another groomer who was short on staff and couldn’t fit him in. This was our 7-month old puppy’s first groom at a groomer (his breeder …
My Pomeranian always looks and smells so good when I pick him up!
I’ve searched high and low for hand stripping and these guys make my dog look incredible
